long_biography.plain_text:
Insurance executive Chris Williams entered the industry through an old school football contact after failing his final school examinations. An early North American assignment changed abruptly when his employer lost its ice-hockey league account and sharply reduced staff. He moved to Phoenix, where he helped develop a medical insurance business.

With his wife Kristine, he bought a neglected Sonoma County winery in 1994 and replanted its vineyards. Wattle Creek expanded its production and sold wine through a San Francisco tasting room as well as wider distribution. Their son Ben became involved in sales and management. The couple sold the winery to the Boisset Collection in 2016.
